title: CostumeHub – Costume Rental Management System
description: A full-featured costume rental management system designed for costume shops and rental businesses. It includes a public-facing catalog with 3D costume previews, a walk-in rental request form, and a comprehensive admin dashboard for managing inventory, rentals, payments, returns, and generating sales reports.

title: CivicHub — Barangay Event Management & Resident Information System
description: A full-stack web application designed for Philippine Local Government Units (LGUs) that streamlines barangay event management, resident registration, and community engagement. Features include event creation with captain approval workflow, QR code-based attendance tracking, digital certificate generation, SMS notifications, and role-based portals for the Barangay Captain, Secretary, Partner Agencies, and Residents.

title: PSU Academic Management System
description: A web-based academic management system designed for university use. It streamlines the management of students, faculty, class sections, subjects, assessments, grading, syllabi, and seat plans. Faculty can record and compute grades, generate PDF/Excel reports, and manage grading weights per subject — all within a role-based platform for admins, faculty, and students.

title: Maxi-Care – Pharmacy Inventory & Sales Management System
description:
A complete inventory and point-of-sale management system built for small pharmacies and drugstores. Maxi-Care handles the full daily flow — receiving stock from suppliers, ringing up sales, tracking expiries, and reporting monthly revenue — through a clean, role-based admin/staff interface.

What's Included:

-Two ready-to-use roles: Administrator (manages staff accounts and views sales reports) and Staff (runs daily operations)

-One-command demo setup with seeded demo accounts. Click-to-fill login buttons on the landing page for instant evaluation

-Polished sale-ready landing page with hero, feature list, and responsive layout (mobile-friendly)

-Full source code, migrations, seeders, and setup guide for both MySQL and PostgreSQL

title: Academic Performance & Certificate Management System
description:
A complete academic management platform for schools covering Elementary, Junior High, Senior High, and College levels. Built around 9 dedicated user roles — Admin, Principal, Chairperson, Registrar, Instructor, Teacher, Adviser, Student, and Parent — each with its own dashboard, permissions, and workflows.

Key Features:
• Multi-level grade approval workflow (Instructor → Chairperson/Principal → Final)
• Automated honor calculation per academic level (Dean's List, President's List, With Honors, and more)
• Certificate generation with customizable templates (PDF & Word output)
• Bulk grade upload via CSV with validation
• Parent portal with full visibility into children's academic progress
• Comprehensive reporting: grade trends, honor statistics, class section reports (PDF + Excel exports)
• Google OAuth single sign-on
• Admin-controlled maintenance mode
• Email notifications for grade approvals, honor qualifications, and account events
• Polished landing page with a built-in demo credentials panel for instant buyer evaluation
• Database-agnostic — runs on both MySQL and PostgreSQL out of the box

Use Case:
Ideal for K-12 to college institutions that need one unified system to manage grades, honors, certificates, and stakeholder communication across multiple academic levels — with strict role-based access control.

title: Hospital Management System with Patient Portal
description:
A full-featured hospital/clinic management system with four distinct user roles — Admin, Doctor, Clinical Staff, and Patient — each with its own dashboard, sidebar, and protected routes.

What's included

Patient portal: book appointments, view medical records and lab results, request record copies, see doctor schedules, manage profile, upload medical files.
Doctor module: dashboard, appointment calendar, consultation history, patient search, medical records (with vital signs and prescriptions), printable records and prescriptions, schedule management, notifications.
Clinical Staff module: medical records, lab records and results upload, appointment management, receipts, record-request approval workflow, doctor-schedule oversight, staff scheduling.
Admin module: user management, hospital services management, doctor schedule oversight, medical-records audit, receipts, reports with PDF download, logs management, settings.
Pre-seeded demo accounts on the login page — one click logs you in as any role for instant evaluation.

Use cases: small to medium clinics, family medicine practices, hospital outpatient departments, capstone/thesis submission, or as a starter kit for any role-based healthcare SaaS.

title: MASTERmind Chess Café — Rating & Café Management System
description:
A live production system built for MASTERmind Chess Café in Angeles City — not a template, a real business running on it every day.

Players join a queue from their phone, walk in, play rated chess on a real board, and climb a café-exclusive leaderboard. The rating engine, the staff terminal, and the café's public pages are all part of the same system.

What it does
Player accounts with username login, profile photos, badges, and in-app notifications.
Custom Elo rating engine with a rank ladder — Pawn, Knight, Bishop, Rook, King, through to Mastermind Champion — capped at 10 rated games a day.
Online queue and café check-in: players queue remotely, staff confirm arrival at the counter.
Staff terminal for starting matches, recording results, one-tap rematches, and handling disputes.
Monthly rewards, membership tiers, and a live leaderboard.
Swiss-Manager CSV import for tournaments run off-site.
Owner-managed content — the café page, menu, coaching, tournaments, and champions are all edited from the admin panel with no developer involved.
Installable as a PWA with its own icon and an offline page.

Built and maintained end to end: database design, row-level security, the rating math, the staff workflows, and the public site.

title: Biyaherong Chess Coach — Chess Training App & Subscription Platform
description:
A subscription chess-training platform for Filipino players, built around FM Deniel Causo — a FIDE Master with a peak rating of 2410. Live on the web and on Google Play.

What it does
10,000+ rated puzzles with their own rating system, so training difficulty tracks the player.
Five AI coaches with distinct teaching styles.
Live engine analysis — players push a position through Stockfish and get it explained.
Opening Trainer built on spaced repetition, so lines are reviewed exactly when they are about to be forgotten.
Puzzle Streak and Puzzle Rush game modes for timed practice.
Video lessons curated by the coach, managed from an admin panel.
Subscription billing with redeemable subscription codes for promos and sponsorships.
Sign-in with Google, plus shareable result cards — streak, rush and rating images are generated on the server so a player's score unfurls properly when posted to Facebook.

Built as a Laravel and Inertia application with a React front end, and shipped as an Android app alongside the web platform.

title: SJA Martial Arts — Martial Arts Academy Website (Swansea, UK)
description:
A booking and programme website for SJA Martial Arts, a family-run academy in Swansea, Wales, with locations at Swansea YMCA, Neath Town Centre and West Cross. An overseas client — the build was delivered from the Philippines to the UK.

What it does
Separate programme pages for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Submission Grappling and Self Defence, each split into kids' and adults' classes.
Discipline pages explaining Combat Jiu-Jitsu, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Submission Grappling to people who have never trained.
A class timetable and a free-trial booking flow, with a sticky call-to-action that follows the visitor down every page.
Member testimonials, a coach introduction video, and click-to-call and email contact throughout.
Google Ads conversion tracking wired in, so enquiries from paid search are attributed to the campaign that produced them.

The whole site is built for one job: turning a search for "BJJ Swansea" into a booked free trial.
